data.description: Per sequence/sidebar-fold-tickets.md §T4. A segmented All · Abstracts · Sessions control leads the submissions list toolbar, replacing the buried kind dropdown; fixed button widths (elements never jump); round-trips through the existing kind query param and saved views. When the program board is filtered to Sessions, a quiet explainer band: 'Sessions are guaranteed — they skip evaluation and enter at Ready to place. The earlier columns are empty by design.' Judges' language ruling: chips stay Abstract/Session. Server-side filtering unchanged (R7); no new query shape. Design contract: prototypes/pipeline-v1.1 submissions + board views (v1.15).

REVIEW — APPROVE (Merge Captain, surface:302; not the author). Merged as 398d622b from head fdd6900c. CI fast-gate pass 7m0s, full list incl. trace:ac --scope=merged. Reviewed twice: first pass at cbb9a978 was CHANGES-REQUESTED — the only new test was a source-text test (readFileSync + regex over .tsx/.css) asserting BEHAVIOURAL acceptance with no behavioural coverage anywhere, i.e. a false green of the MRQ-192 genre (31 catalogued; the MRQ-178 example passes with its comparator inverted). Second pass at b9543846 verified real coverage: write direction (click writes kind=session while PRESERVING an unrelated param), reflect direction (previously zero coverage), all three saved-view legs, and both arms of the board note. I specifically checked the trap that would have made the fix cosmetic — extraction leaving production rendering an inline twin while the test drives the extracted copy — and confirmed SubmissionsPage.tsx:862 renders the tested component in the real toolbar and updateQuery:408 delegates to the same URL builder the test drives. One implementation, pointed at production. Implementation verified: segment leads the toolbar, old kind <select> genuinely removed, fixed 82px widths (elements never jump), existing kind param with no new query shape, server-side filtering untouched (R7), chips still Abstract/Session per the judges' ruling. Final red was trace:ac invalid-title-prefix x4 — a naming contract, not a defect; fixed at fdd6900c with CONTRACT · MRQ-206 · prefixes, bodies untouched.
